Episode 248. Welcome to Laprarosa (1)
May 25, 1804, a week had passed since Laprarosa was liberated.
"Wow, it's so crowded here."
"Isn't that person from the Plutonian clan!?"
"I think so? Look at the glowing heart, and the tail...!"
An unprecedented crowd had gathered in the Mitra Desert. Today was the day 'Laprarosa' was opened to the public for the first time.

Ordinary people just wanted to see Laprarosa, dignitaries from various places, knights, wizards, beastfolk, dragons, demons, media, and personnel of the Barmel Alliance deployed for the reconstruction of Laprarosa.

Countless people were flocking to Laprarosa. The Barmel Alliance seemed determined to turn the opening of Laprarosa into a festival for everyone to enjoy, creating paths with magic throughout the desert and deploying thousands of staff.
It was a time when a festival was needed.

People were tired from the continuous massive wars, starting from the Sword Emperor War. When Gliac appeared, when the Evil God was born, during the ongoing cold wars between the great powers, and even until recently, when demons and red plutonians from the underworld suddenly emerged and wreaked havoc.
For the common people, it was impossible not to think about 'the end of the world.' Everyone felt that it wouldn't be strange if the world suddenly came to an end one day.

They longed for the ordinary wars between people, states, and powers. In this strange era, terrifying and transcendent beings that seemed to belong only in bizarre prophecies would appear out of nowhere and threaten the world.

Amidst all this, the Barmel Alliance conquered Zito and even completely resolved the even worse Red Plutonians threat. At the center of ending Gliac and defeating the Evil God, there was always the Barmul Alliance and Jin.
Therefore, the liberation of Laprarosa was not just an empowerment for Jin. It added great hope to all those who pinned their hopes on him, wishing him to save the world.
The Barmul Alliance is not a force that has built high walls to live well among themselves. Even Jin himself considered the liberated brothers not as his own but belonging to everyone here.
"Please look here for a moment!"
"Oh, uh, like this?"
"Kyahh, so handsome."
"The fur on his hands is so charming too! I just want to touch his tail...!"
"Hey, Mr. Plutonian! What's your name?"
"Well, I'm Shaku but... please don't touch the tail."

"I saw you, Dino Jaglun, on the Laprarosa special! Shaku the Thunder, the man who brutally defeated Lord Jin when he first visited Laprarosa! You fought him fifty times and won all fifty, so you're the person who has defeated Lord Jin the most after Queen Alisa of Tikan. Queen Alisa has won over a hundred times!"

In fact, the Plutonian clan already had fan clubs. Enya and Sandra's unofficial and official Jin fan clubs merged into 'Barmul Alliance Support Group (shortened to BASG),' and the Plutonian fan club was rapidly emerging as one of its fastest-growing subgroups.
"Our BASG Plutonian fan club will always support you!"
It was a natural phenomenon in some ways.
In this dark and desperate era, suddenly a mysterious and strongest race known to have disappeared half a million years ago awakened and fought for the world.
Just the background alone was charming enough, but the Plutonian themselves, each with their own personality, strangely stimulated the imaginations of boys and girls.

Most of the Plutonian clan had no immunity to the behavior of humans who adored and worshiped them. So, like Shaku, they often awkwardly blushed when faced with fervent expressions, which was a reversal charm from the fan club's perspective.
Not all were like Shaku. Tantel was already showing skilled fan service as if he were a popular theater actor, and Belize was like the hearty sister next door.
Linpa was often caught while trying to escape the attention and felt embarrassed, and Teto screamed at the rushing fans but always signed autographs.
For people, Laprarosa was a world of dreams and hopes, filled with strong and adorable Plutonian.
The Barmel Alliance was diligently working to create this atmosphere for the opening event of Laprarosa, allowing everyone to casually approach the Plutonian or alliance members.
"Everyone, please line up here for the popularity vote! Currently, Battle God Ban is in first place!"
"Vote and then enter the Hall of Battle God! Soon, Lord Jin and Battle God Ban will appear!"

Ban had not yet appeared. Even if Dino had not detailed her exploits since the Evil God Temple, she would still have been in first place. Even considering the entire alliance, Ban's popularity was third after Jin and Luna.
"Lord! Your Excellency's popularity is amazing! As expected of Your Excellency...!"
"Your Excellency... I've never heard such an expression in my life, Jet."
"Lord, in this world, there is only one 'Lord,' and only two 'Your Excellencies.' One is Battle God Ban, and the other is Lord Siron."
"Haha, Jet. I wonder if you could even speak in front of father. Oh, maybe not? Father has become much kinder, so maybe you could say a word or two?"
Runtia laughed at Jet's words.
"Perhaps even before transcending, father might have lightly smiled at being called 'Your Excellency,' Sister Runtia."

"I agree with the youngest. During the Black Sea Expedition, father was strangely merciful towards Ozdok. Since Jet was in the same department as Ozdok, you probably were fine, right? When I first returned, I mistook Jet for Ozdok."
"Hey, Jet, you scoundrel. Then shouldn't I be called 'Your Excellency' too?"
"Hmm, Lord Murakan is Lord Murakan."
"It's somehow infuriating. I should have shaped him up more in Akin. Now he's got clout, and it's awkward to scold him like before."
"Ahem! Even though I, Jet, am now a dignified Barmel Alliance officer, the Seven Colors Chief of Intelligence, and Lord's darling, am I not?"
Murakan grunted, and Gilly laughed softly, offering him a piece of strawberry pie.
"Oh strawberry pie, being fed by you, it's too precious..."
"You should eat it quickly, Lord Murakan. Battle God Ban will be coming out soon."
Though there was a pretext, Gilly's lips did not leave the smile as she watched Murakan accept the strawberry pie. As usual, Jin felt a chill and turned away from the two.
"Murakan, let's go. It's time."
Veil entered the Hall of Battle God. Jin and Ban were scheduled to give a speech, and during that time, he, Murakan, and the golden ship were planned to show their dignity from above.
"Anyway, I can't enjoy my time with the strawberry pie, everyone. Strawberry pie, how about we walk around Laprarosa later and help with the repairs!"
"That sounds great, Lord Murakan. Let's drink tea and read books together while secretly repairing, and share stories."
Murakan, excited, stepped outside with Veil.
"What a funny idea, thinking you can slack off here without me knowing."
As soon as they heard that voice, Gilly unknowingly stood up and covered her mouth.
It was Ban's voice, just arriving among the comrades. Of course, Ban had no intention of scolding Gilly. Just as Gilly was about to reply, Ban quietly placed her hand on her shoulder.
"Strawberry... I mean, sorry. I've gotten used to that nickname too. Anyway, Gilly, you are like a mother to my brothers. Therefore, you can be as free as me in Laprarosa."
Ban had always treated Gilly this way since the day of liberation.
"Our Plutonian clan can bring all the gold in the world, erase the sea, and tear the sky for you if you wish."
The other comrades also stood up to greet Ban.
"Ba, Battle God Ban. You don't have to go that far."

"I will prepare cocktails and tea with the brothers later. Since the best room in the Hall of the Battle God is going to be empty, you can spend a good time there repairing with Murakan. If you want to choose the atmosphere, like the color or texture of the blanket, feel free to talk about it..."
"Wha-!? A, a blanket!?"
"Er, um! Battle God Ban?"
Jin's voice was on the verge of cracking in confusion. Ban, finding their reaction amusing, let out a low laugh.
Ban seemed very happy. Since liberation, the Plutonian clan has been enjoying life in the Human World every day like this.
The wounds from the liberation war had not fully healed. Even Ban needed time, having suffered from dimensional errors and bombardment by the Red Plutonians throughout the war.
However, fundamentally, Ban's rank had not been damaged. From now on, she planned to devote everything for Jin and the world he sought to reach, along with her brothers.
"Hehe, Lord Jin's embarrassed face is always fresh."
"Battle God Ban being mischievous is quite fresh too."
Ban stood side by side with Jin.
Then, as Jin nodded, the alliance soldiers drew back the curtains covering the Hall of the Battle God balcony. The crowd's enthusiasm and cheers intensified, and the two slowly stepped towards them.
At that moment, the cheers stopped as if by magic.
Everyone who had been shouting the names of Ban, Jin, and the Barmel Alliance fell silent. Without any orders or restrictions, Ban's dignity gently enveloped the crowd.
When the two appeared on the balcony, not even a breath could be heard, despite the millions stretching from the Hall of the Battle God plaza to the far end of the Golden Road.
"Welcome, everyone, to Laprarosa."
She didn't bother to announce her position or name. From the moment she stepped out with Jin, everyone in the desert knew she was Battle God Ban.
